title: Sanskrit Numbers 1–100

conventions.cardinal_1_to_4: Masculine, feminine and neuter nominative forms are supplied in that order.
conventions.cardinal_5_to_100: A conventional citation/counting form is supplied; numbers 20–99 are traditionally feminine singular numerals.
conventions.ordinal: Ordinal adjectives are supplied in masculine, feminine and neuter nominative singular forms.
conventions.ordinal_20_to_100: The regular -tama ordinal formation is used consistently for transparent classroom reference.

sources: Whitney, Sanskrit Grammar, §§487–488 (ordinal formation and gender)
Bucknell, Sanskrit Manual, sections on numerals
Ramkrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute, Saṅkhyāvācanam reference
